location: Phường Đồng Nguyên, tỉnh Bắc Ninh
content:
As one of the projects completed during the first six months of 2026, Edison Hanaka International Primary and Secondary School represents a forward-thinking approach to educational architecture, where every space is thoughtfully designed to support the long-term development of both individuals and the community.

The design is guided by sustainability from its very foundation. Natural daylight, ventilation, landscaped environments, and open spaces are integrated as essential architectural elements to enhance the quality of the learning environment while improving long-term operational efficiency. Located in Dong Nguyen Ward, Bac Ninh Province, the project is envisioned as a modern K–12 international school with lasting adaptability. Each space is carefully planned to balance educational functionality, operational efficiency, and user experience, creating a flexible learning ecosystem rather than traditional enclosed classrooms, in line with the dynamic and contemporary spirit of an international school.
